title: Definitions for 815 KAR Chapter 20
short_summary: Defines all key plumbing terms used throughout the Kentucky plumbing code, including master plumber, journeyman plumber, plumber's apprentice, maintenance man, public building, and plumbing.

title: Plumbing Fixtures
short_summary: Establishes requirements for plumbing fixtures including water closets, lavatories, sinks, bathtubs, and showers. Sets minimum clearances and connection requirements.

title: Waste Pipe Size
short_summary: Establishes minimum sizes of traps, soil, and waste branches for each fixture type. Contains the DFU (drainage fixture unit) table and pipe sizing requirements.

title: Soil, Waste, Vent Systems, Traps, and Clean-Outs
short_summary: The most comprehensive section. Covers venting requirements (no wet venting in KY), trap placement, trap-to-vent distances, cleanout spacing, vent stack through-roof requirements, prohibited connections, and materials for DWV systems.

title: Water Supply and Distribution
short_summary: Covers potable water supply systems, pipe sizing, backflow prevention (air gap, RPZ, double check, vacuum breaker), cross-connection control, thermal expansion, and water heater requirements.

title: House Sewers and Storm Water Piping
short_summary: Covers house sewer connections, storm water piping, combined sewers, and requirements for sewer pipe materials and installation.

title: Inspections and Tests
short_summary: Establishes inspection and testing requirements. Water test with 10-foot head of water. Air test. Concealed work must be inspected before covering. Remote inspection provisions. License revocation for fraud.

title: Special Connections
short_summary: Covers indirect waste connections, acid waste systems, dilution pits, grease interceptors, and other special plumbing connections.

title: Minimum Fixture Requirements
short_summary: Specifies minimum number of plumbing fixtures (water closets, lavatories, drinking fountains) required by building type and occupancy.

title: Kentucky Plumbing Law (KRS Chapter 318)
short_summary: The statutory law governing plumbing in Kentucky. Defines master plumber, journeyman plumber, apprentice. Establishes licensing requirements, permit requirements, penalties for violations, and the authority of the Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction.

title: Administrative Regulations (815 KAR Chapter 2)
short_summary: Administrative procedures for plumbing regulation in Kentucky including permits, fees, examinations, and appeals processes.

title: Plumbing Licenses
short_summary: Establishes requirements for plumbing licenses in Kentucky. Master plumber exam requires 80% passing score. Journeyman exam requires 75%. Covers exam scheduling, fees, and license renewal.
